participation.context: Kept the ticket in his sleeve, answered with three hours, and promised nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the debts cheerfully and low, showed the scrap once, and put it away.
participation.name: John Shakespeare

participation.context: Remembered the colour without naming it, and took the wish off the supper table.
participation.name: Mary Shakespeare

relations.note: the gentleman, and then the wool
relations.quote: They'd have made me a gentleman once, Will. Then wool fell.

story.body: You came at the debts and were seen coming. He named three sizes smaller than the list in your sleeve, and you did not answer them. The scrap came out, the heralds were refused, and your mother ended it by remembering a colour she did not name. The panel took the paper back.
